content.query:
SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://myncplstorageaccnt.dfs.core.windows.net/csvfile/people.csv',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) 
WITH (
    [User_Id] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [First_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Last_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Sex] VARCHAR(20) ,
    [Email] VARCHAR(200),
    [Phone] VARCHAR(200) ,  -- Keeping VARCHAR to avoid BIGINT conversion errors
    [Date_of_birth] DATE,
    [Job_Title] VARCHAR(100) 
) AS people;

Select name,collation_name from sys.databases;

Alter database testing collate Latin1_General_100_CI_AI_SC_UTF8


Create EXTERNAL data SOURCE hide_link
With(
	Location='https://myncplstorageaccnt.dfs.core.windows.net/'
)


SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'csvfile/people.csv',
	DATA_SOURCE='hide_link',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) 
WITH (
    [User_Id] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [First_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Last_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Sex] VARCHAR(20) ,
    [Email] VARCHAR(200),
    [Phone] VARCHAR(200) ,  -- Keeping VARCHAR to avoid BIGINT conversion errors
    [Date_of_birth] DATE,
    [Job_Title] VARCHAR(100) 
) AS people;

Create view my_view
AS
SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'csvfile/people.csv',
	DATA_SOURCE='hide_storage_link',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) 
WITH (
    [User_Id] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [First_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Last_Name] VARCHAR(100) ,
    [Sex] VARCHAR(20) ,
    [Email] VARCHAR(200),
    [Phone] VARCHAR(200) ,  -- Keeping VARCHAR to avoid BIGINT conversion errors
    [Date_of_birth] DATE,
    [Job_Title] VARCHAR(100) 
) AS people;


Select * from my_view
